neighbours.label: A noun naming an attribute or relation of something else, at the point where it is specified: ' title' (chapter/job title), ' sources' of, units of ' measurement', Chinese 的原因 ('the reason for'); a list, since 'purpose of' and 'types of' stay quiet
fire: The editor changed the article title twice before it went to print.
Farmers disagree about the best sources of potassium for sandy soil.
Her official title at the bank was never made clear to the staff.
他迟到的原因是早上错过了第一班公交车。
The first lesson covers the standard units of measurement used in the lab.
The essay's title promised more than its pages delivered.
Doctors still argue over the main sources of vitamin D in winter.
公司搬迁的原因是市中心的租金太高。
quiet: The editor changed the article twice before it went to print.
Farmers disagree about when to plough sandy soil.
Her office at the bank was never opened to the staff.
他早上错过了第一班公交车，所以迟到了。
The first lesson covers the safety rules used in the lab.
The essay promised more than its pages delivered.
Doctors still argue over how much sleep people need in winter.
市中心的租金太高，所以公司搬走了。

short: relational nouns: title, sources, 的原因
notes: Weak pole (max 6.4). Card: materials, 的原因, functions, title, sources, Measurement, 名叫, 重点.
